title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights. You bring: willingness to learn around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller; solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics); experience with or a strong interest in Power BI; strong analytical skills; the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models; a curious and proactive approach to solving problems; the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working; an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve; a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data; fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable. experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What we offer This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics.
